title: Gamebook evidence for the 2026-11-16 SGP legs whose players have no box-score row (F139 follow-up)
purpose: Answers the question F139 left open: were Banchero and Ty Jerome inactive for the 11/16 games, or did they play? The nba.com box-score pages read earlier rendered no stat table; the official gamebook PDFs print an `Inactive:` line naming every player not in uniform, which is the league's own document for exactly this fact.
rule: A player is recorded appeared=false only when the gamebook's `Inactive:` line names him with a reason. No row is created for a player who is merely absent from a table: absence from a table is not evidence of inactivity.
source_note: The nba.com box-score pages failed to render a stat table for these games (nav/marketing text only), so the gamebook PDF is the primary read and the game URL is cited as the companion official page.

players.evidence: Inactive line, verbatim: "Inactive: Magic - Banchero (Injury/Illness - Right High Ankle Sprain)"
players.corroboration: official injury report 11/16 01:15 PM ET and 01:30 PM ET both list Banchero, Paolo / ORL / Out

players.evidence: Inactive line, verbatim: "Inactive: Grizzlies - ... Jerome (Injury/Illness - Right Hip Soreness)"
players.corroboration: official injury report 11/16 01:30 PM ET lists Jerome, Ty / MEM / Out

scope_limit: This file records PLAYER APPEARANCE ONLY. It does not grade the SGP tickets and does not change any units. The SGP tickets on the 2026-11-16 slate remain UNSETTLED in data/settlement/settlement_2026-11-16.json (sgp_settled 0, total_units_settled -5.8) unless and until a settlement record settles them. Leg status and ticket settlement are two different facts and this file states only the first.
